task.name: libero_bolt size-based bolt sorting
task.goal: Sort every bolt listed by R.todo() into its size-matched bin (small->blue, large->red), one bolt at a time, then return home.
success_criteria: In(bolt_small_1, parts_bin_blue_1) holds for every small bolt in the todo list
In(bolt_large_1, parts_bin_red_1) holds for every large bolt in the todo list
R.check() returns True at end of episode
Robot is back at home pose after the last placement

scene.workcell: LIBERO/MuJoCo Franka Panda parallel-jaw table at z=0.90 m; blue bin (small bolts only) and red bin (large bolts only) side by side at table front, bins fixed at 90 deg; bolts lie flat with long axis ~X at randomized initial poses

steps.purpose: Let the lying bolts finish sinking/rolling (~13 mm in first frames) before any perception or grasp point is computed
steps.on_failure: log settle anomaly and re-run settle(30) once before aborting

args.message: episode start: reading R.todo() pair list

steps.purpose: Record the todo list of (bolt, bin) pairs to be sorted this episode
Perceive which bolts are present and confirm ids match the todo list before first motion
steps.on_failure: log missing/extra bolts and abort rather than grasp an unverified object

steps.purpose: Human confirmation before releasing enable for the first motion (task book section 6)
steps.on_failure: stay at home pose and abort episode

steps.purpose: Top-down grasp on the shank (not hex head) of the small bolt when the todo list contains bolt_small_1
steps.on_failure: log grasp failure, R.home(), retry once, then skip and report

steps.purpose: Carry small bolt over blue bin, lift >=100 mm first, release within 30 mm of cavity floor
steps.on_failure: log placement failure, R.home(), retry once, then report failed pair

steps.purpose: Top-down grasp on the shank of the large bolt (38 mm hex / 103 mm long, higher risk) when the todo list contains bolt_large_1
steps.on_failure: log grasp failure, R.home(), retry once, then skip and report

steps.purpose: Carry large bolt over red bin, lift >=100 mm first, release within 30 mm of cavity floor
steps.on_failure: log placement failure, R.home(), retry once, then report failed pair

steps.purpose: Return to safe home pose after all todo pairs are processed
Verify the episode goal predicate In(bolt, bin) for all sorted bolts
steps.on_failure: log which bolt/bin pair failed the predicate and report as failure case

constraints.text: Never move below z=0.86 m and never leave |x|,|y| <= 0.40 m; end effector must not go below table 0.90 m outside bin cavities
Grasp must be top-down on the bolt shank, not on the hex head, and must not strike bin outer walls
Carry speed <= 0.15 m/s; any single continuous displacement > 450 mm counts as long travel and needs confirmation
Lift >= 100 mm before any lateral motion to avoid dragging the part
Release only within 30 mm of the bin cavity floor; never drop from height
One bolt at a time; finish placement before touching the next bolt
Bins are fixed at 90 deg orientation; do not rotate or move the bins
Small bolts only into parts_bin_blue_1, large bolts only into parts_bin_red_1

risks.text: Bolt sinks/rolls ~13 mm during first ~30 sim steps, invalidating precomputed grasp points
risks.mitigation: R.settle(30) is step 1 before any scan or pick
risks.detect: compare scan pose before/after settle; log settle delta

risks.text: Vertical grip on the 38 mm hex head slips for the large bolt
risks.mitigation: grasp on shank with hex-head flange as axial stop; retry once on failure
risks.detect: grasp failure return from R.pick and post-lift check

risks.text: Fast carry throws the part out of the jaws
risks.mitigation: carry speed <= 0.15 m/s enforced by safety layer
risks.detect: post-place R.check() and visual loss of object in agentview

risks.text: Long travel > 450 mm between bolt and bin triggers unreported motion
risks.detect: distance computed from current pose to bin center

risks.mitigation: targets map fixed in plan; place box argument hard-coded per bolt id

confirmations.when: before step 5, after settle and scan
any single displacement > 450 mm between bolt and bin
